questions.question: Who among the following has received the Vigyan Ratna Award in Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Prof. Govindarajan Padmanabhan**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prof. Govindarajan Padmanabhan r**eceived the **Vigyan Ratna Award in the 2024 Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar**
 
• He is known for being a **Pioneer of molecular biology and biotechnology research in India**
 
• **He is NASI Honorary Scientist an**d Professor at the Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore
 
• The **Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar is India's most prestigious science award**, and it recognises individual and team achievements in science and technology. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Key Awardees of the Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar 2024**

 
 
• The key awardees of the Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar 2024 include the following:
 
• **Vigyan Ratna**: G. Padmanabhan was honored with the Vigyan Ratna for pioneering research in malaria parasites besides general contributions to biological sciences. The retired director of the Indian Institute of Science also won Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan for his work.
 
• **Vigyan Team: **The Team of Chandrayaan-3 was awarded the Vigyan Team award for the mission's success in marking the first ever landing of an Indian spacecraft on the moon in the year 2023, a milestone indeed in the space exploration history of the nation.
 
• **Vigyan Shri**: This was awarded to three senior scientists, namely; Annapurni Subramaniam, for research in the field of star cluster and galaxy formation and evolution; Jayant Bhalchandra Udgaonkar, for physics in biology; and Naba Kumar Mondal for his contributions to particle physics.
 
• **Vigyan Yuva**: The three young scientists who have been honored with Vigyan Yuva are Vivek Polshettiwar for his significant contribution towards carbon capture technologies, Urbasi Sinha for her quantum research, and Roxy Mathew Koll for his contribution towards climate science.

questions.question: Which legendary musician, known for his work in films like 'Amar Akbar Anthony' and 'Bobby', was awarded the Padma Bhushan on Republic Day 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pyarelal Sharma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Pyarelal Sharma** is part of the famous music director duo Laxmikant-Pyarelal, known for their iconic music in Indian cinema.
 
• He has worked in numerous films including **'Amar Akbar Anthony'** and **'Bobby'**.
 
• On Republic Day 2024, he was awarded the prestigious **Padma Bhushan** for his contribution to Indian music.
 
• The Laxmikant-Pyarelal duo has composed music for over 500 films, earning a legendary status in the Indian music industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The Padma Bhushan is the third-highest civilian award in India.
 
• It is awarded to recognize distinguished service of a high order to the nation, in any field.
 
• The award was instituted on **2 January 1954** by the Government of India.
 
• Recipients of the Padma Bhushan are announced every year on Republic Day.
 
 
 
• **Laxmikant-Pyarelal**
 
 
• Laxmikant-Pyarelal were a popular Indian composer duo, consisting of** Laxmikant Shantaram Kudalkar** and **Pyarelal Ramprasad Sharma**.
 
• They composed music for over 500 Hindi films from 1963 to 1998.
 
• They were known for their versatility in creating music that ranged from classical to modern tunes.
 
• Some of their most famous works include music for the films 'Bobby', 'Amar Akbar Anthony', 'Karz', and 'Ram Lakhan'.
